Type: table
Name: Stone & Beam Jon Casual Farmhouse Expandable Wood Dining Table, 90"W, Birch
Colors: Beige
Materials: wood
40"L x 74-90"W x 30"H Solid hardwood made of poplar; birch veneer A simple design and rustic finish make it casual and ideal for a modern farmhouse décor A great table for dining or homework; self-storing leaf Assembly in 30 minutes or less; attach base to top Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This handsome rustic rectangular table is ideal for a lake house -- or for adding a warm natural touch to your home. Solid hardwood and sturdy construction will last through many family dinners. An extra leaf allows you to accommodate more guests.
